references.text: Describes Israel's route from Egypt and mentions the Arnon as the border of Moab, the same geographical area claimed by the Ammonite king.
Relates how Israel conquered the land between the Arnon and Jabbok from Sihon, the same territory the Ammonite king demands back.
God forbade Israel to attack the Ammonites directly, which is relevant to the Ammonites' claim on the land.
Confirms that Israel did not take the Ammonites' land but stayed away from the Jabbok River as a boundary.
Mentions Sihon's kingdom extending from the Arnon to the Jabbok, the same area referred to in the Ammonite king's claim.
Describes the inheritance of the tribe of Gad in this region, which included half of the Ammonites' land.
Refers to Israel's departure from Egypt and their arrival in this area, which the Ammonite king references.
